text: Hello everyone, welcome to the English class.Please prepare your textbook, workbook, notebook and your stationery for the class.Remember this rhyme?Try to say it with the flash.Let's do read and choose first.Please take out your notebook and write down the answers from 1 to 5.Let's check.Number 1, how to read it?Yes, grass, we choose B.Number 2, roll, choose B.Number 3, leave, choose C.Number 4, match, we choose A.Number 5, thick, choose C.Are your answers correct?Good.Can you talk about fire safety in the forest, at home and at school?Have a try.Well done.Here is a sign.No campfires.We can say it in another way.Don't start campfires.We can also say You mustn't start campfires.Read these sentences by yourself.Here is another sign.No smoking.Can you use different ways to express the sign?Please take out your notebook and write down the answers on it.Don't smoke.You mustn't smoke.Please read these sentences by yourself.At the beginning of the unit, we had a brainstorm.We wrote some words about fire.Now, do you know more about fire?Today, Ms.Fan and her students are having a discussion about fire.She has a question.Please listen.Children, what do you know more about fire?Let's read it together.Let's listen to Danny first.Fire is useful.It gives us heat and light.People use fire in many different ways.At home, we use fire to cook food and boil water.What does Danny think of fire?He thinks fire is useful.Because it gives us heat and light.Can you read these sentences by yourself?Do the students have different ideas?Let's listen to Kitty.Fire is dangerous.It can burn down a lot of trees and buildings.It can hurt people too.What does Kitty think of fire?She thinks fire is dangerous.Because it can burn down a lot of trees and buildings.Danny thinks fire is useful.Kitty thinks fire is dangerous.What do you think?What does Miss Fang think of fire?Fire can be useful.Fire can be dangerous.We must be careful with fire.Miss Fang thinks fire can be useful.Each coin has two sides.We use fire in many different ways.But fire can hurt people too.So we must be careful.Read Miss Fang's words by yourself.Miss Fang shows a sign.What does this sign mean?Alice says it means don't start campfires.It means don't start campfires.Danny says it means we mustn't start campfires.Read it by yourself.And Kitty says it means we can't start campfires.So we can use don't, we mustn't, and we can't to express the sign.Please read the whole dialogue by yourself.How about this sign?What does it mean?It means don't play with matches.It means we mustn't play with matches.It means we can't play with matches.And these sentences can be in different orders.Great!Danny makes some signs for fire safety in the forest.Now let's do part B.Ask and answer.Can you be Danny and answer my questions?You please.Can we play with matches?Good job!The students know a lot about fire.Now they're going to make an introduction about it.Kitty wants to have a try.She takes some notes.There are three parts.Let's read them together.For fire safety, what mustn't we do?Can you talk about fire with Kitty?Let's look at the first part.What does fire give us?At home, what do we use fire to do?Try to say it by yourself.Kitty can talk about this part.She can get one star.If you can talk about this part, please take out your notebook and draw a star for yourself.Then let's talk about the second part.Can you talk about this part by yourself?She can get the second star.If you can, draw one more star for yourself.Let's move on to the third part.Fire safety.Where can fire start?Fires can start in forests, in schools, at home and many other places.For fire safety, what must or mustn't we do?Kitty can talk about this part by herself.Fires can start in the forest, at school and at home.For fire safety, we must be careful.In the forest, we mustn't smoke.We mustn't start campfires.We mustn't play with matches.At home, we mustn't smoke.She can get the third star.If you can, draw the third star for yourself.Congratulations!This time, can you say something about fire?Leslie can talk about it.Please listen to her.Fires can start in the forest, at home and in many other places.In the forest, we mustn't start campfires.We mustn't smoke.At home, people mustn't smoke.Children mustn't play near fires.Excellent!And you can do it well too.From this unit, we know fire can be useful.Fire can be harmful.We must be careful.No safety, no fire.Here are the assignments.One, write about fire safety in or at a place.If you have any difficulties, the exercise on page 84 of your workbook can help you.Two, talk about fire.Three, visit Shanghai Fire Museum for more information.It is optional.So much for the class.Goodbye.
